opportunities.title: Automate Bug Detection and Reviews
opportunities.summary: Automate Low Hanging fruit bug detection and issue creation recursively. This issue is an issue focused on creating more issues: 1. Find a feature/bug to work on from this repository 2. Create a GitHub issue on the repository to start working on it -- Pull requests without issues will not be considered. 3. Use the following string in the issue that you created: "This issue is limited only to the creator of this issue. This means that only the issue author can attempt to solve this issue. If you would like to work on it, please create another issue with the same contents and refer to issue #11398 for more information." Follow all instructions carefully and precisely. /bounty $800 Bounties can only be paid upon successful PR merge.

opportunities.title: Add mutual_insurance_pool() where stakers collectively cover each other's principal loss
opportunities.summary: ## Summary Distinct from Issue #190 (purchased insurance from admin fund). opportunities.title: Add reward_top_up_allowlist() restricting which addresses can add reward tokens
opportunities.summary: ## Summary Currently any address can transfer reward tokens to the contract address directly, potentially confusing accounting. Add an allowlist restricting which addresses are permitted to officially top up the reward reserve via a dedicated function, keeping reward accounting clean and auditable. ## Acceptance Criteria - [ ] `add_reward_supplier(admin, supplier: Address)` — whitelist a reward supplier - [ ] `remove_reward_supplier(admin, supplier: Address)` — remove from whitelist - [ ] `is_reward_supplier(supplier: Address) -> bool` read-only query - [ ] `supply_rewards(supplier, amount: i128)` — only whitelisted suppliers can call - [ ] Transfers `amount` reward tokens from supplier to contract - [ ] `RewardSupplied` counter incremented: `total_rewards_supplied` lifetime tracker - [ ] `get_total_rewards_supplied() -> i128` read-only query - [ ] `rewards_supplied` event: `(supplier, amount, new_balance, ledger)` - [ ] Admin is automatically a reward supplier — cannot be removed - [ ] Tests: whitelisted supplier adds rewards, non-whitelisted rejected, admin always can supply, event emitted correctly ## Notes - Does not prevent direct token transfers to contract address — only con
